topic: IT Roadmap and Upcoming Feature Releases
summary_markdown:
A roadmap was outlined covering several IT initiatives. These include: locally administered systems only, integration of AllUnite LiDAR, and dashboard improvements for mall and airport projects (specifically a track-to-store update dashboard). Other planned features involve an impression model, setting up data monitoring/health checks, firmware updates from Teltonika, and Confluence permissions.

Discussion focused on the timing of announcing the next release. [p1] indicated that the announcement should happen within the week or so.
decisions: The IT roadmap includes LiDAR integration, dashboard improvements for mall/airport projects, an impression model, and data monitoring setup.
action_items: [p1] needs to clarify the timing of announcing the next release (within the week or so).
